prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for peppermint tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single clear glass mug (slight sage-green tint) filled with a pale translucent green peppermint infusion — one small fresh peppermint leaf floats on the surface. The mug is placed slightly off-center (lower right). Scattered around it on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: three fresh peppermint sprigs with bright sage-green leaves (one longer sprig curving gracefully across the composition), a few loose leaves, and a single tiny white flower. Negative space dominates — at least half the image is clean bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradient volumes. Leaves have clean silhouettes with gentle soft-shaded vein hints, NOT painterly brushstrokes. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy edges. Warm diffuse morning light from upper right casts a gentle soft shadow under the glass. Feels fresh, energizing — a clear visual contrast to the warm chamomile card. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
